{{Quote|Vader tell you that he killed our last pilot?"<br />"No, but I can only assume that he gave Lord Vader a good reason to do so.|Starkiller and Juno Eclipse, talking about the pilot|<ref name="TFU" />}}
An '''individual''' served in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] at some point during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]]. He was selected as the seventh [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] for the ship ''[[Rogue Shadow]]'', used by "[[Galen Marek|Starkiller]]," the secret apprentice of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. However, the pilot was later killed by Darth Vader himself sometime before or in [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]].<ref name="TFU">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref>
